blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Cebuano architect Josephril Partosa is bringing a distinctly Filipino touch to the redevelopment of the historic Rizal Memorial Stadium in Manila, inspired by the country’s being known as the “Pearl of the Orient Seas.” Partosa is leading the stadium’s architectural and design work. He plans to incorporate flowing curves into the proposed structure, drawing inspiration from the natural beauty and symbolism of a pearl. He likened the spectators to the pearl itself, while the stadium’s shape represents the clam that encases it.
